function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 45 mph on urban interstates (unless posted otherwise)
• 35 mph on highways with 2–3 lanes (unless posted otherwise) | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001‑545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts (except for certain motorcycle riders).
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Lower limits for commercial drivers and drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, mandatory alcohol‑education programs, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.051‑545.055 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system). | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• Give right‑of‑way to emergency vehicles with flashing lights. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021‑545.023 | | **School‑Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of fire hydrants, driveways, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required for certain vehicle types. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Commercial Vehicle Rules** | • Hours‑of‑Service (HOS) regulations for truck drivers.
• Additional licensing requirements for hazardous materials. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021‑545.023 | | **Penalties & Fines** | • Varies by offense; can range from $50 to $1,000+ plus points on driver’s license. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Official site for driver licensing, vehicle registration, and law enforcement updates. 👉 https://www.dps.texas.gov/ 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text of all traffic statutes. 👉 https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TX/htm/TX.545.htm 3. **Texas Driver Handbook** – Practical guide for new drivers, including road signs, rules, and safety tips. 👉 https://www.dps.texas.gov/Programs/Driver-Services/Driver-Handbook 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific case law or recent rulings affecting traffic law enforcement in your area. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re designed for safety, not convenience. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on the phone. - **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular maintenance reduces accidents. - **Stay alert for school buses** – they have special stopping rules. - **Know your local ordinances** – some cities have stricter parking or speed limits than state law. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular type of violation (e.g., reckless driving, speeding thresholds in a specific city), let me know and I can pull up the exact statute or even search for recent court cases related to that issue.
